_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the turnstile machine's structure + context shape. The codegen emits both the C# and TypeScript structure from this; behavior (guards/reducers) is hand-written per language and bound by name.

transitions.guardMessage: Only a quarter or a dollar is accepted.

differential._comment: Feeds the exhaustive cross-runtime differential corpus. `samples` are representative inputs per trigger (a no-input case is always added). No `seeds` are needed: Coin sets paidWith, so Unlocked is reachable from the initial Locked snapshot by driving the machine's own transitions.
